title: Say Sumpa na Daakan ya Ani
intro: Diad sakey a bansa nensaman, walay sakey a kamarerwa ya kaiba ed saray sankayamanan ed komunidad da. Amiduan sinmabi ed sikara so bendisyon na dalin ed nantutumbokan a taon, sakey a doblin panag-ani a nepeg komon a mamapano ed puso ra na pisasalamat. Balet nen agawa so trahedya tan amin a kayarian da et inala ed sakey a labi, say ebat da so angipatnag na peteg a inkatoo na kamarerwa ra. Sarag mo kasin naamtaan no siopa iyan too ya say istorya to et manserbin pasakbay sumpad agpanisia ed saray bendisyon nen Allah?
clues: Kaiba ak ed saray sankamapalaran a kamarerwa ed interon dalin, ya abendisyonan na daakan a tagano.
Amiduan sinmabi ed siak so panag-ani ed loob na duaran taon, balet ta say pusok et nansiansian agmisalamat ed Katawan ko.
Walaan ak na baleg a hardin a walaan na saray ubas, olibo, tan kiew a palma—sakey a paneknek ed pabor nen Allah.
Nen aderal so hardin ko, nanalagey ak ed saray geray to ya akaunat iray limak ed tawen, ya insambak so kapalaran ko.
Imburi ko ya si Allah so sengegan na ontan ya inkaandi, anggano pinmeket ko ray limak lapud inkaandi-ilalo.
Say dusa ko et aliwan say inkaandi labat na hardin ko, noagta say inkaandiay nagawaan ko ed saray geray to, ya agmakapangiter na katulongan.

identity.label: Siopa ak?
options: Say akankayarian na hardin ed Surah 26
Say akankayarian na duaran hardin a nanlapud arawin dalin
Sakey a mayaman a kamarerwa a nanlapud syudad na inkaaligwas
Say dumaralos ya abitla ed Surah Al-Kahf
Sakey a manag-asikaso na kaubasan manlapud panaon nen Propeta Shu'aib
identity.answer: Say akankayarian na hardin ed Surah 26

trial.label: Trial/Event
options: Say inkaandi na sakey a hardin ya aderal ed sakey a labi
Say baleg a delap ya amaknol ed dalin
Say pakasubok ed saray tua tan palson propeta
Say subok na pangibantak ed apoy
Say subok ya akmonen na dalin
trial.answer: Say inkaandi na sakey a hardin ya aderal ed sakey a labi

location.label: Manunan Elemento
options: Sakey a hardin a walaan na saray ubas, olibo, tan palma ya aderal ed loob na duaran taon
Sakey a barkon ginawa ed atagey a palandey
Say syudad na sakey a nasyon a nankasalanan
Sakey a bobon ed kadaanan a Midian
Say ilog na paraiso
location.answer: Sakey a hardin a walaan na saray ubas, olibo, tan palma ya aderal ed loob na duay taon

outcome.label: Pansumpalan
options: Sigpot ya inkaandiay nagawaan—aderal ya anggapoy ontulong
Kioli ya onloob ed paraiso
Say pagmaliw ya propeta nen Allah
Pangulo na sakey a baleg a bansa
Andi-anggaan a dusa ed apoy
outcome.answer: Sigpot ya inkaandiay nagawaan—aderal ya anggapoy ontulong

verse: He said, "Yes, and indeed, you will then be of those near [to me]." (26:42-44)
